source_passages.section: Setup — Vagabond setup (9.3), starting items and relationships
source_passages.quotation: Take S-marked starting items listed on character: tea, coins and bags go face up on matching tracks, other items face up in Satchel; return unused S items to box. Place each other faction's relationship marker at Indifferent.

answer.ruling: Choose Thief, Tinker or Ranger, and place the Vagabond pawn in any forest.
Shuffle the quests and display three face up.
Take the character's listed S-marked starting items. Put tea, coins and bags face up on their matching tracks; put other items face up in Satchel; return unused S-marked items to the box.
Set every other faction's relationship marker to Indifferent.
